name: Synn
message: 「How's the decorating coming along at the main gate?」

name: Shio
message: 「Waaah! Lady Sacchin, you must not let go just yet!」

name: Shio
message: 「That decoration nearly struck Lord Synn directly!」

name: Synn
message: 「Sorry for making you guys help out like this」

name: Shio
message: 「Not at all, something like this is a trifling matter!」

name: Synn
message: 「Honestly, the Student Council is supposed to be supervising on-site, though...」

name: Sacchin
message: 「Yeah, but you and the others are super busy with other tasks, right?」

name: Sacchin
message: 「You can just leave things here to us!」

name: Synn
message: 「Still, I'll come by to check in every now and then」

name: Synn
message: 「No problem. I want us all to work hard and make this a fun festival, after all」

name: Synn
message: W-Why is there a Demon here!

name: Sacchin
message: Aah! Don't touch the decorations! I worked so hard to make them!

name: Shio
message: Stand back, Lady Sacchin! I shall vanquish this fiend myself!

name: Synn
message: Ah, it's too dangerous to go alone, Shio-chan!

name: Shio
message: There is no need for concern

name: Shio
message: For today, I, Shio Asukai, shall finish it off for good!

name: Shio
message: Now then, foul spirit…… pre-pare to di-e!

name: Macaron
message: Nufufu, your training is still way too lacking

name: Macaron
message: With swordsmanship like that, you'll never defeat the great Macaron

name: Shio
message: I am completely unharmed. However, who is this person……?

name: Sacchin
message: Ah! It's the kid from the other day

name: Macaron
message: Hey, what's the big idea, slashing at someone out of nowhere?

name: Shio
message: I did announce my name beforehand

name: Macaron
message: What do you think would've happened if I'd been even a second later!
Well, Shio-chan probably would've been the one taking the damage, though.

name: Macaron
message: 「Big Bro, you're bullying Demons again without learning your lesson!」

name: Synn
message: 「Hmm, I did try to stop it, you know」

name: Synn
message: 「Ah, well, um, it's kind of like the relationship between Misa and you, Shio-chan」

name: Shio
message: 「I see. Come to think of it, I have heard tell from my elder sister」

name: Shio
message: 「That a bizarre little girl posing as a Demon Lord has been appearing around the academy lately...」

name: Macaron
message: 「Don't say 'posing as,' that makes it sound shady!」

name: Macaron
message: 「Besides, you're plenty of a little girl yourself!」

name: Shio
message: 「What did you say?! I am still very much in the middle of growing!」

name: Macaron
message: 「I'm gonna shoot right up soon too and be all va-va-voom!」

name: Shio
message: 「In my estimation, Lady Macaron has already reached her limit」

name: Macaron
message: 「Grrrah! Don't talk nonsense! Aren't you the one who's stopped growing?!」

name: Shio
message: 「Between myself and Lady Macaron, who do you believe has more room to grow?!」

name: Synn
message: 「W-Well, it seems like Macaron drinks milk every day... so Macaron, maybe?」

name: Macaron
message: 「Huh? Drinking milk makes you grow taller?」

name: Shio
message: 「Ugh, how cruel of you, Lord Synn...」

name: Synn
message: 「Ah, no, I'm sure you will eventually too, Shio-chan!」

name: Shio
message: 「Lord Synn! Might you spare a bottle of milk for me as well!」

name: Shio
message: 「At the very least, I must reach the same level as Lord Synn!」

name: Macaron
message: 「Whaaat~? Are you trying to compete with me?」

name: Macaron
message: 「Hmm. Well then, if someone challenges me, I have to accept it fair and square!」

name: Shio
message: 「Ho-ho. It seems you understand proper etiquette」

name: Shio
message: 「Do not stop us! This is a serious duel between women with our pride on the line!」
At the exact same time, the two pop the caps off their milk bottles!
The two of them ready their weapons at the same time!

name: Shio
message: 「Now then, let us duel fair and square!」

name: Synn
message: 「Don't start sword-fighting in a place like this!」

name: Macaron
message: 「I'm just the type who can't half-ass anything!」

name: Macaron
message: 「Still got a long way to go, though!」

name: Shio
message: 「M-My true potential is far greater than this!」

name: Synn
message: 「Gah! You don't need to show us that!」

name: Macaron
message: 「Nufufu, then let's see what you've got!」

name: Synn
message: 「Aah, I have to do something fast……」
There's no time to worry about appearances.
She leaves herself completely wide open!

name: Macaron
message: 「Hey, Big Bro! Don't get in the way!」

name: Synn
message: 「Come on, Macaron, if you keep thrashing around, I'll confiscate yours too」

name: Macaron
message: 「Hyaaa! Not that! Definitely not that! You coward!」

name: Shio
message: 「Lord Synn... um, not only are you shameless, you are tyrannical as well...」

name: Synn
message: 「Well, we won't get any work done if things stay like this」

name: Sacchin
message: 「Waaah! How long is this kid gonna stay here--!」

name: Shio
message: 「For one such as myself to act so disgracefully, how utterly shameful...」

name: Macaron
message: 「Mgh... When you put it like that, I guess I don't have a choice, but...」

name: Macaron
message: 「In the first place, it's your fault for picking on that kid, Big Bro」

name: Macaron
message: 「Huh? What is it, what is it...」

name: Macaron
message: 「Um... 'It sounded really lively and fun, so I just came over to take a peek,' they say」

name: Synn
message: 「I see! So this excitement really does get through to a Demon too!」

name: Macaron
message: 「...If you weren't bullying them, then, uh, sorry」

name: Shio
message: 「Regarding that matter, I too am deeply reflecting on my actions...」

name: Synn
message: 「Ah, don't worry about it, don't worry about it. Miraculously, nobody even got hurt」

name: Synn
message: 「Besides, having a strong sense of justice is a good thing」

name: Synn
message: 「You seem to be pretty into this stuff, so if you'd like, wanna tag along and watch?」

name: Synn
message: 「Alright! Well then, just be careful not to make too much noise, okay?」

name: Shio
message: 「Hmm... For Sir Synn's sake, I shall let this slide...」

name: Sacchin
message: 「Hmm... Looking closely, maybe it's kinda cute?」

name: Synn
message: 「You're not in the middle of a part-time shift, right?」

name: Macaron
message: 「...Fine. I'm worried about this kid, so I'm coming with」

name: Macaron
message: 「Don't get the wrong idea! I'm just this kid's guardian, that's all!」
Bringing along the grumbling Macaron and her merry companions, I patrol the school grounds ahead of KiraFes.
Everyone seems like they can barely wait for tomorrow's main event.
Alright, now it's finally time for the final push!
